office_does: A Snohomish County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to the district-court limit, and protection orders, and is elected by the voters of the court's electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Patricia Lyon, on the Evergreen District Court bench since 2003, is the only candidate. Elected by Evergreen District voters only.

candidates.summary: Evergreen District Court judge since 2003 and former deputy prosecutor, running unopposed.
highlights: Evergreen District Court judge since 2003; says she has been elected six times [S1]
